assessment: Intentional variable-arity tagged immutable fingerprint values; no fixed-arity return contract defect found in the inspected consumers.

findings.reason: Absent defaults use (none,); positional and keyword defaults carry their tag and immutable nested payload. The result is embedded in the function fingerprint, never unpacked as a fixed-width record.
Tags select different exact-type identity/code/default/class/container payloads. Recursive callers retain opaque nested state. tuple[object,...] explicitly allows different tag-specific widths.

The immutable native attrgetter needs three entries; the mutable CPython sentinel binds six entries including class and instance state. State is explicitly tuple[object,...], and None means this leaf form is not admitted here.

consumer_evidence.observation: _HelperBinding.capture stores the complete state; unchanged first requires exact value identity and then compares complete tuple equality.
Other state uses recurse or carry opaque values; registry consumption combines unchanged booleans, not tuple positions.

rule_scope: A generic fixed-length tuple API recommendation is not a demonstrated unpacking or authority bug for these private tagged fingerprints.
status: Three original open code-smell findings are preserved; this source assessment does not mark them resolved or change the quality gate.
